However, the assistant realizes that perfect squares are an exception. Perfect squares have an odd number of divisors because one of the divisors is repeated (the square root). The assistant concludes that the lockers that remain open are those whose numbers are perfect squares. This is because only perfect squares have an odd number of divisors, leading to an odd number of toggles, which changes the locker's state from closed to open.
